source: 590 The Truth Behind the Seal
target: 590 Veritas Post Sigillum

source: 590 The Truth Behind the Seal
target: 590 Veritas Post Sigillum

source: The surface of the massive silver-gray behemoth ignited with illusory doors, casting a star-like brilliance that darkened the sky above the sea.
target: Superficies ingentis bestiae argenteo‐cinerei portis illusoriis fulgebat, proicens splendorem siderum similem qui caelum supra mare obscurabat.

source: This existing seal, triggered by Madam Magician, no longer resided in a nadir due to celestial shifts.
target: Hoc sigillum, a Magistra Magica excitatum, propter mutationes caelestes in fundo iam non manebat.

source: Starlight descended, swiftly repairing the temporary damage inflicted upon the seal.
target: Lux siderum descendit, celeriter reparans damna temporaria in sigillo intulata.

source: Inside the behemoth, half of the grayish-white fog composing Mad Lady’s human form was absorbed by the metal floor, appearing as if it would sink further.
target: Intra bestiam, dimidium nebulae cinereo‐albae quae formam humanam “Mad Lady” constituebat, a plano metallico absorpta est, quasi ulterius mergi posset.

source: In that crucial moment, starlight permeated the walls, floor, and ceiling, materializing resplendent doors of various shapes.
target: In illo momento cruciali, lux siderum pervagata est per parietes, pavimentum et laquearia, efformans portas resplendentes variis figuris.

source: These doors manipulated the void, thwarting the menacing suction and expelling the grayish-white fog.
target: Hae portae vacuum moderabant, repugnantes sugitioni minaci et expellentes nebulam cinereo‐albam.

source: Abruptly, Lumian felt the formidable suction force from the metal tunnel’s depths dissipate.
target: Subito, Lumian sensit vim sugitionis formidabilem, quae ex infimo canali metallici emanabat, evanescere.

source: He “saw” the dented flesh and blood “bird’s nest” expanding again, releasing a copious amount of resplendent starlight.
target: Vidit carnem et sanguinem in forma “nidus avium” deformatum iterum expandere, copiosam lucem siderum resplendentium eruentes.

source: The torrent surged through different parts of the silver-gray behemoth like a flood breaching a dam.
target: Torrentia per varias partes bestiae argenteo‐cinerei irruit, quasi diluvium damnum frangens.

source: Lumian, Mr. K, Mad Lady’s remains, and the items undulated with the sea’s waves.
target: Lumian, Dominus K, reliquiae “Mad Lady” et cetera res cum fluctibus maris undabantur.

source: As they were propelled forward, they encountered resistance and erosion from the sea’s power.
target: Dum impellebantur, occursit eis resistentia atque erosio ex potentia maris.

source: Meanwhile, the fleshless, corporeal grayish-white phantom swayed in the vast starlight, growing fainter before gradually dissipating.
target: Interim, phantasma corporale, sine carne, cinereo‐album in immensa luce siderum vacillabat, paulatim evanescens dissolvens.

source: Unlike previous instances, the sea’s power did not erupt from the ocean depths this time.
target: Contrario prioribus, potentia maris hoc tempore ex profundis oceani non erupit.

source: Madam Magician had severed the energy passageway, successfully resealing and reinforcing the seal.
target: Magistra Magica viam energeticam abscidit, sigillum iterum claudens atque confirmans.

source: Madam Magician, her form seemingly illusory, raised her right hand and pointed at the betrothal ship and sailboat, her eyes mirroring the corresponding scene.
target: Magistra Magica, cuius forma quasi illusoria videbatur, dextram manum levavit et navem nuptialem atque velarium navale monstravit, oculis scenam illam speculantibus.

source: The two ships, along with Hela, Franca, the “Cinderella” demigod, the humanoid Sealed Artifact, the Maidens of the Sea, the remaining deputy hosts, and the sailors, vanished from the underwater cavity, instantly reappearing on the sunny, calm, turquoise sea beyond the seal.
target: Duae naves, simul cum Hela, Franca, semideo “Cinderella”, artefacto humanoideo sigillato, Puellis Maris, reliquis hospitibus vicariis atque nautis, ex cavitate subaquanea evanuerunt et statim in mari solario, placido, turcico colore ultra sigillum apparuerunt.

source: Crash! Mountain-like azure waves and jade-green seawater resembling well walls slammed down, filling the underwater cavity.
target: Fragor! Undae caeruleae, quasi montes, et aqua marina viridi‐jade, quae parietibus puteorum similes erant, ruunt, cavitatem subaquaneam replentes.

source: Madam Magician’s gaze then shifted to Lumian, Mr. K, Mad Lady’s corpse, Pride Armor, and other items.
target: Deinde, aspectus Magistrae Magicae ad Lumian, Dominum K, cadaver “Mad Lady” et Armaturam Superbiae atque alias res versatus est.

source: Just as she was about to relocate them, Lumian, still donning the Flog boxing gloves, suddenly felt a heavy, dense, terrifying, and brilliant aura “looking” at him from another place connected to the black hole in the flesh and blood “bird’s nest.”
target: Modo cum illa eos transferre intendebat, Lumian, adhuc in manibus Flog pugnandi indutus, subito sensit gravem, densam, terribilem atque fulgentem auram, quae ex alio loco, coniuncta ad foramen nigrum in “nidus” carnis et sanguinis, eum intueri videbatur.

source: Crack, crack.
target: Crepitus, crepitus.

source: Lumian heard his bones shattering, his skull caving in, ribs snapping, and flesh compressing layer by layer.
target: Lumian audivit ossa sua ruere, cranium concavari, costae rumpi, atque carnem strato per stratum comprimere.

source: After unleashing the Ascetic’s accumulated strength, he, now taller, was instantly compressed into a short, thin, and dense form.
target: Postquam vires asceticas cumulatas dimiserat, ille, nunc altior, statim in brevem, tenuem atque densam formam comprimi coepit.

source: Intense pain flooded his mind, and his brain began to passively contract.
target: Dolor intensus mentem eius inundavit, et cerebrum eius passim contrahere incipiebat.

source: After a moment, Lumian broke free from the gaze and floated into the gradually calming air.
target: Post momentum, Lumian ex spectatione evasit et in aere paulatim quietante fluitavit.

source: Before Madam Magician, an illusory book rapidly flipped, emitting a faint glow full of vitality.
target: Ante Magistram Magicam, liber illusorius celeriter volutabat, parvam lucem vitalitatis emittens.

source: It bathed Lumian’s body in light, reconstructing his broken bones and swiftly enlarging his compressed flesh, rescuing him from his near-death state.
target: Illud corpus Lumiani luce perfudit, ossa fracta reficiens et carnem compressam celeriter dilatans, eum ex statu prope mortis eripiendo.

source: Then, Madam Magician tossed Mad Lady’s rose‑gold ring embedded with the crimson gem to Lumian, allowing him to reassemble his flesh and blood and return to his original appearance.
target: Deinde, Magistra Magica annulum ex auro roseo, gemma rubra imbutum Dominae Insolitae, Lumiani iacuit, eum permittens carnem et sanguinem iterum componere atque ad formam originalem redire.

source: He was no longer a short, thin, and heavy peculiar human.
target: Non iam erat homo brevis, tenuus et gravis, peculiaris.

source: Simultaneously, in Port Santa, Loki’s figure faded as he entered the spirit world, preparing to teleport away.
target: Simul, in Portu Santa, figura Loki evanuit, dum in mundum spirituum ingrediebatur, paratus ad se teleportandum.

source: However, a dark, formless barrier appeared in front of him, blocking his path.
target: Attamen, obstaculum obscurum, sine forma, ante eum apparuit, iter eius obstruens.

source: Loki’s pupils dilated as he realized that at some point, he had been ensnared in a dark and transparent “sphere,” seemingly bent from the void, with “walls” everywhere, and a hidden door.
target: Pupillae Loki dilatatae sunt, cum intellexit se aliquando in sphaera obscura et perspicua, quasi ex vacuo flectentem, ubique parietibus et ianuam occultam habentem, implicatum esse.

source: High up in the spirit world—near the seven pure lights—Madam Magician hovered, adorned in a deep‑black Warlock robe adorned with stars.
target: Alte in mundo spirituum — prope septem lucis puras — Magistra Magica manebat, induta nigerrima veste magica, stellis ornata.

source: Loki’s presence registered in her eyes, and an illusory book rapidly flipped before her.
target: Praesentia Loki in oculis eius manifesta erat, et liber illusorius celeriter volutatus ante eam fuit.

source: She had strategically waited until the last moment to prevent Loki from receiving the Celestial Worthy’s warning, providing her an opportunity to capture him alive.
target: Ea strategice exspectaverat ad ultimum momentum, ne Loki monitum a “Celestiali Digno” acciperet, sibi occasionem ad eum vivum capiendum praebens.

source: Loki’s lips curled into an exaggerated smile upon understanding the situation.
target: Labia Loki in risu ampliato convoluta sunt, cum rem intellexit.

source: Rumble!
target: Tumultus!

source: His body erupted from the inside out, as if a self‑controlled bomb had been embedded in his flesh beforehand.
target: Corpus eius ex intimo in exterius erupit, ac tamquam bombus sui moderatus antea in carne eius insitus esset.

source: Loki’s bizarre suicide succeeded; flesh and blood splattered, and his aura dissipated.
target: Suicidium insolitum Loki perfecit; caro et sanguis sparsi sunt, et aura eius evanuit.

source: Madam Magician promptly lifted the seal on the area, capturing the information Loki had imprinted in the spirit world.
target: Magistra Magica celeriter sigillum in regione levavit, captans informationem quam Loki in mundo spirituum inscripserat.

source: The spirit world served as a repository for all information.
target: Mundus spirituum depositorium omnium notitiarum erat.

source: Divination often entailed revelations from the spirit world, and the matter of resurrection inevitably left corresponding information.
target: Divinatio saepe revelationes e mundo spirituum afferebat, et res resurrectionis necessario informationem correspondentem relinquebat.

source: As long as she found relevant information in time, Madam Magician could trace Loki to his resurrection spot and pinpoint the ancient castle documented in the Secret Order records.
target: Dummodo notitiam pertinentem tempestive inveniret, Magistra Magica Loki ad locum resurrectionis eius vestigare poterat atque antiquum castrum, in tabulis Ordinis Secreti depositum, designare.

source: Soon, Madam Magician obtained something.
target: Statim, Magistra Magica aliquid obtinuit.

source: Her figure vanished from the spirit world’s heights, navigating the endless darkness adorned with symbols.
target: Figura eius evanuit ex altitudinibus mundi spirituum, navigans in tenebris infinitis symbolis ornatis.

source: In the next moment, a vast grayish‑white fog materialized before her eyes.
target: In proximo momento, vasta nebula cinereo‑alba coram oculis eius materializata est.

source: Magician halted, gazing at the seemingly endless expanse of grayish‑white fog.
target: Magistra Magica se sistit, aspiciens immensam nebulae cinereo‑albae expanse, quae inaniter videbatur.

source: Under the silent, dusky sky, above the calm blue sea.
target: Sub caelo silentio ac crepusculo, supra mare placidum caeruleum.

source: Using Mad Lady’s ring embedded with a crimson gem, Lumian adjusted his internal organs, flesh, and bones to their original state.
target: Utendo annulo Dominae Insolitae, gemma rubra inlata, Lumian organos internos, carnem et ossa ad statum pristinum restituit.

source: Treading on the corporeal wind, Lumian removed the ring that enabled the use of flesh and blood magic and anxiously inquired of Madam Magician, “How’s the situation on the other two fronts?”
target: Ambulans super vento corporali, Lumian annulum, qui usum magiae carnis et sanguinis permittebat, removit atque anxie Magistrae Magicam rogavit: “Quid agitur in reliquis duobus frontibus?”

source: As he spoke, he sensed a mystical and indiscernible flicker from Madam Magician.
target: Dum loquebatur, sensit scintillationem mysticam atque imperceptibilem a Magistra Magica emanare.

source: Magician smiled.
target: Magistra Magica risit.

source: “Loki has just been killed by me, but I couldn’t prevent his resurrection or seize the opportunity to locate his ancient castle.
target: “Loki modo a me interfectus est, sed nec resurrectionem eius prohibere potui nec occasionem ad inveniendum antiquum castellum eius capere.”

source: Bard has been captured by Gandalf, whom you intentionally sent to Milo Village. He’s alive.”
target: “Bard ab Gandalf captus est, quem ad Vicum Milo proposito misisti. Vivus est.”

source: Phew… Lumian instinctively heaved a sigh of relief.
target: Heu… Lumian instinctu suspirum solatium edidit.

source: Though he hadn’t captured Loki, wasting one more of Loki’s resurrections meant he had achieved his objectives.
target: Quamquam Loki non cepit, iterum eius resurrectionem amittere significabat se propositum adeptum esse.

source: Furthermore, Ultraman and Mad Lady had been completely eliminated, and Bard had been captured alive.
target: Praeterea, Ultraman et Domina Insolita omnino exstincti erant, et Bard vivus captus est.

source: The results were satisfactory.
target: Eventus satisfactori erant.

source: Initially, Lumian hadn’t confirmed Bard’s identity.
target: Initio, Lumian identitatem Bard non confirmaverat.

source: He didn’t even know if Bard had participated in the sea prayer ritual.
target: Nescius erat etiam utrum Bard ritu precationis maris participavisset.

source: However, he had a few suspects, including the fake Governor of the Sea and Juan Oro’s grandson, Fernandez.
target: Attamen, aliquos suspectos habebat, inter quos falsum Praefectum Maris et nepos Juan Oro, Fernandez.

source: Since most of the suspects were in Milo Village, he had Gandalf closely monitor them.
target: Cum plerique suspecti in Vicum Milo essent, Gandalf eos arcte observare curavit.

source: Madam Magician continued, “I relocated everyone else from these waters.
target: Magistra Magica perrexit: “Reliquos ex his aquis omnes transfeci.

source: I sent Mr. K of the Aurora Order back to his rented room in Port Santa.
target: Dominum K Ordinis Aurorae ad cellam locatam in Portu Santa redei.

source: Mad Lady’s corpse and items are floating here.”
target: Cadaver Dominae Insolitae et instrumenta hic fluctuant.”

source: The Major Arcana card holder opened her palm, shrouded in darkness, forming a small box.
target: Possessrix chartarum Maioris Arcana palmas suas aperuit, in tenebris operta, parvam capsulam formans.

source: Inside, Mad Lady’s dismembered corpse and other items had “shrunk” to the size of mosquitoes, drifting as if in another world.
target: Intus, cadaver Dominae Insolitae disiunctum et cetera instrumenta ad dimensionem culicidarum redacta erant, quasi in alio mundo vagantia.

source: Lumian was taken aback.
target: Lumian obstupefactus est.

source: He looked at the bottom of the azure sea and asked, “Is it over?”
target: Aspiciebat imum maris azuri et rogavit: “Iam finitum est?”

source: He had anticipated gaining control over the silver-gray behemoth eventually.
target: Praevidit se tandem potiri imperio super bestiam argenteo‐cineream fore.

source: “Otherwise? Back then, even two Kings of Angels couldn’t clean up the mess.
target: “Aliter? Illo tempore, etiam duo Reges Angelorum confusionem purgare non potuerunt.

source: How is our Tarot Club going to handle it—unless Mr. Fool awakens,” Madam Magician replied in an amused tone.
target: “Quomodo nostrum Tarot Club id administrabit—nisi Dominus Stultus excitatus fuerit?” respondit Magistra Magica alacri tono.

source: Lumian recollected the items in the flesh and blood “bird’s nest” and nodded in agreement.
target: Lumian instrumenta in “nidus avium” carnis et sanguinis recoluit, atque consensu annuit.

source: He asked in confusion, “Is it true that sealed at the bottom is a black hole? Uh… Do you know what a black hole is?”
target: Rogavit confusus: “Verumne est quod in imo sigillatum sit foramen nigrum? Eheu… Scisne quid sit foramen nigrum?”

source: “I do,” Madam Magician chuckled.
target: “Scio,” inquit Magistra Magica subridens.

source: “And I also know that the silver-gray thing down there is a spaceship.”
target: “Et etiam scio rem argenteo‐cineream illac deorsum esse navem sideralem.”

source: Spaceship… Lumian was taken aback.
target: Navis sideralis… Lumian obstupefactus est.

source: Upon reflection, he realized that the silver-gray behemoth bore a striking resemblance to the spaceship described in his sister’s bedtime stories!
target: Post considerationem, intellexit bestiam argenteo‐cineream mirabilem affinitatem habuisse cum nave siderali, quam in fabulis ad somnum sororis suae descripta erat!

source: Madam Magician not only knew about spaceships but also grasped the concept of a black hole!
target: Magistra Magica non solum de navibus sideralibus sciebat, sed etiam notionem foraminis nigri intellexit!

source: Never underestimate high-ranking individuals.
target: Numquam personas altae dignitatis subestima.

source: The time‑transcending knowledge possessed by transmigrators might not be foreign to them… Lumian sighed with emotion.
target: Scientia, quae tempus transcendit, quam transmigratores possident, eis non foranea esse poterat… Lumian cum affectu suspiravit.

source: At that moment, he noticed that Madam Magician’s mystical flickering had vanished.
target: In illo momento animadvertit scintillationem mysticam Magistrae Magicae evanuisse.

source: The Major Arcana card holder gazed at the seabed and explained, “It’s a black hole, ready to form, personally created by an evil god.
target: Possessrix chartarum Maioris Arcana imum maris contemplata est et explicavit: “Foramen nigrum est, formandi paratum, a deo malefico personaliter creatum.

source: Constantly absorbing surrounding matter and energy, it strengthens itself, eventually becoming a true black hole.
target: Continenter materiam et energiam circumstantem absorbet, se roborans, tandem verum foramen nigrum efficitur.

source: “In the Fourth Epoch, the evil god seized an opportunity to send the embryonic black hole through the spaceship at the bottom of the sea.
target: “In Aetate Quarta, deus maleficus occasionem cepit ad mittendum foramen nigrum embryonicum per navem sideralem in imo maris.

source: The plan was for it to rapidly develop, tear apart, and devour our planet, causing the barrier to lose support and disintegrate prematurely.
target: Consilium erat ut celeriter evolveretur, dissolveretur, et planetam nostrum devoraret, quo impedimentum sustentationem amitteret atque prae‐mature dissolveretur.

source: True gods and angels could escape, but without the barrier’s protection, who knows what would happen.
target: Veri dei et angeli evadere poterant, sed sine tutela impedimentorum, quis sciat quid eveniret.

source: Fortunately, Mr. Door and Amon discovered the threat in time and took action.
target: Fortunate, Dominus Ianuam et Amon minas tempore deprehenderunt et rem ceperunt.

source: Yet, they couldn’t obliterate the already developing black hole.
target: Attamen, foramen nigrum iam evolvens delere non potuerunt.

source: Any attempts to destroy or destabilize it would only make it stronger.
target: Omnis conatus ad delendum aut destabilizandum id tantum roboraret.

source: The only viable solution was to seal it and patiently wait for it to weaken through repeated radiations until it ultimately evaporates.
target: Sola solutio valida erat id sigillare et patienter exspectare ut per radios repetitos debilitaretur donec tandem evanueret.

source: Alternatively, they could transport it and the spaceship into the cosmos, abandoning it in desolate areas.
target: Aliter, id et navem sideralem in cosmo transferre poterant, relicto in regionibus desolatis.

source: However, this would require Mr. Door to leave the safety of the barrier and shadow the threat continuously to prevent accidents.
target: Attamen hoc significaret ut Dominus Ianuam tutelam impedimenti relinqueret et minas constanter subsequeretur ad casus evitandos.

source: Moreover, it remained under the vigilant gaze of that entity, which periodically replenished its energy through their connection.
target: Praeterea, remanebat sub vigilante aspectu illius entitatis, quae periodice vim suam per eorum connexionem renovabat.

source: The danger was evident.
target: Periculum manifeste patebat.

source: That explains it… Lumian finally grasped why it had been sealed rather than destroyed.
target: Hoc explicat rem… Lumian tandem intellexit cur sigillatum esset potius quam delevitum.

source: Intrigued, he echoed a term, “Mr. Door?”
target: Curiosus, verbum repetivit: “Dominus Ianuam?”

source: It bore a striking resemblance to Mr. Fool.
target: Illud notabile similitudo habebat cum Domino Stulto.
